name: Teashell 5% Niacinamide Brightening Serum | Alpha Arbutin & Ascorbyl Acid | Dark Spot & Acne Mark Care | For All Skin Types | 30ml
description:
Reveal brighter, smoother, and more radiant-looking skin with Teashell 5% Niacinamide Brightening Serum. Formulated with Niacinamide, Alpha Arbutin, and Ascorbyl Acid, this lightweight serum helps improve the appearance of dark spots, acne marks, dullness, and uneven skin tone while supporting hydration and a healthy-looking skin barrier. Suitable for daily skincare routines and all skin types.

Key Features
Enriched with 5% Niacinamide for brightening and skin care
Contains Alpha Arbutin to help improve the appearance of dark spots
Ascorbyl Acid helps support a radiant-looking complexion
Helps reduce the appearance of acne marks and uneven skin tone
Supports smoother and more refined-looking skin texture
Helps maintain skin hydration and softness
Supports the skin's natural moisture barrier
Helps manage the appearance of excess oil and shine
Lightweight formula absorbs easily into the skin
Suitable for normal, oily, dry, combination, sensitive, and acne-prone skin
Suitable for daily skincare use
Leaves skin feeling fresh, smooth, and hydrated

Product Specifications
Product Type: Skin Brightening Serum
Main Active Ingredient: 5% Niacinamide
Additional Ingredients: Alpha Arbutin and Ascorbyl Acid
Net Volume: 30ml
Skin Type: All Skin Types
Texture: Lightweight Serum
Usage: Daily Skincare Routine

How to Use
Cleanse and dry your face before application
Apply a small amount of serum to the face
Gently massage or pat until fully absorbed
Follow with a suitable moisturizer
Use sunscreen during the daytime
Perform a patch test before first use, especially on sensitive skin

Material / Composition
5% Niacinamide
Alpha Arbutin
Ascorbyl Acid
Hydrating and skin-conditioning ingredients

Safety Information
For external use only
Avoid direct contact with eyes
Perform a patch test before first use
Discontinue use if irritation occurs
Keep out of reach of children
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
